name: io.github.tensorpass/aiconnect-docs
title: AI Connect docs
description: Search and read the AI Connect SDK docs: quickstarts, SDK reference, wallet protocol and MCP tools.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the AI Connect documentation: quickstarts, the SDK reference, plugging an existing AI SDK (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gen AI, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex) into the visitor's wallet, the MCP tools guide, the wallet protocol, security and supported accounts. Returns the best matching pages and sections with their paths; read one in full with read_doc.

query.description: Words to search for, such as useAiChat, McpToolSource or OpenAI SDK

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: One page of the AI Connect docs as Markdown, with its code samples. Takes the path from search_docs or list_docs, such as /docs/quickstart/react. A long page comes in parts: the answer says which part it holds and how many there are.

part.description: The part of a long page to read, from 1

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: Every page of the AI Connect docs with its title, path and summary, the same index as llms.txt.
